categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates and manages Beijing Capital International Airport, including aeronautical services such as aircraft landings, take-offs, passenger services, ground support, and firefighting. It also operates non-aeronautical businesses including ground handling agent services, in-flight catering, duty-free and retail shops, restaurants, VIP services, advertising leasing, property leasing, car parking, and provision of ground handling facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced airport operation management systems, including an upgraded intelligent safety system and smart safety management platforms. It integrates digital and smart service management systems, energy management systems, and cybersecurity frameworks. The company also focuses on green technologies such as photovoltaic power generation and energy-efficient building management to support sustainable airport operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic and international airlines operating at Beijing Capital Airport, including 85 fixed commercial airliners from 47 countries and regions. The company serves passengers, cargo operators, retail and concession tenants, and other airport users. Major customers include Air China Limited, which accounted for about 31% of total revenues in 2022.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Mainland China, specifically at Beijing Capital International Airport. Its services cover domestic routes including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, as well as international routes connecting 47 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream entity in the civil aviation supply chain, managing airport operations and providing services to airlines and passengers. It also engages in upstream activities such as procurement and maintenance of airport facilities and infrastructure through subsidiaries and related parties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing safety and operational quality, advancing the development of Beijing Capital Airport as a world-class international aviation hub, and promoting green and smart airport initiatives. The company emphasizes cost control, service quality improvement, aviation hub construction, and innovation in business operations. It also focuses on ESG governance, climate change response, and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through aeronautical fees (aircraft movement fees, passenger service income) and non-aeronautical sources including rental income, concession revenues (advertising, retail, restaurants, car parking, VIP services), and resource usage fees. The company also earns income from property leasing and various service agreements with subsidiaries and related parties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading airport operator in China, managing one of the busiest airports in the country. It operates alongside Beijing Daxing International Airport under a 'dual-hub' model. The parent company also operates Daxing Airport, which competes in aeronautical and non-aeronautical businesses. The company positions itself as a safe, green, smart, and humanistic international aviation hub.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.23 billion, a 33.3% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on air traffic. It recorded a net loss after tax of RMB 3.53 billion. Total assets were RMB 33.48 billion with equity of RMB 16.6 billion. The company experienced significant declines in passenger throughput and aircraft movements but anticipates recovery in 2023 with increasing flight volumes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes safe, convenient, and high-quality airport services, integrating advanced technology and sustainable practices to enhance passenger experience. It differentiates itself through comprehensive aeronautical and non-aeronautical services, strategic hub development, strong ESG governance, and a commitment to green airport initiatives. The company also focuses on innovation in service delivery, operational efficiency, and building a benchmark service standard in China.
